Afrobeats star David Adeleke, popularly known as Davido, and his wife, Chioma, on Thursday paid a visit to the Minister of Interior, Olubunmi Tunji-Ojo.
Tunji-Ojo disclosed this in a post on his X account, saying the couple had stopped by to greet him.
“Earlier today, my friend and brother and popular artiste, Davido and his wife, Chioma, stopped by to say hello,” he wrote.
Photographs shared alongside the post showed Davido embracing the minister in one frame, while another captured the singer prostrating to greet him.
